text:
JWT `exp` in seconds. `Date.now()` in milliseconds.

**Bug:**
```js
if (Date.now() > payload.exp) // wrong — always true or never true
```

**Fix:**
```js
if (Date.now() / 1000 > payload.exp) // convert ms → s
```

Or:
```js
if (Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) > payload.exp)
```

**Better:** ditch manual check. Use library.

```js
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken'

jwt.verify(token, SECRET) // throws TokenExpiredError if exp passed
```

`verify` handle expiry, signature, malformed — all at once. Manual check miss signature validation anyway.
